description:
The Letras frameset is a super-light platform that offers an extremely refined feeling of the road. The timeless lines offer a very discrete look that will surprise you with the butter-like feeling that steel is known for.The original version built with rim brakes can still be ordered. #savetherimbrake

"Designed around a single word: Delight. Letras is an unpretentious bike with one clear goal—to give the rider the purest, most enjoyable sensation on a bike. In a world where climbing is measured in watts and gradients, we’ve taken the opposite approach, amplifying the indescribable joy of finding your rhythm on the ascent while syncing your body and mind with the environment."

components.description: Every frameset comes with a small set of touchup paint and framesaver.
